title: Window labels are opaque (win-<n>) not semantic (tool-<id>), capabilities scoped by label pattern
context: Semantic labels like tool-<id> made 'one window per tool' true by construction but required detection logic when detaching.
decision: Labels minted by ShellState as win-<n>, carrying no meaning. Capabilities scoped with glob patterns matching these labels.
consequences: Window with no matching capability glob gets no permissions, silently failing to initialize. Glob and label generation must change together.
